answer: An attacker therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The thread counter is kept in fable and whisper publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Scaling to 688 identities multiplies that fee by 476 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
